decision: The frozen Phase D observation, feature, label-endpoint, chronology, preprocessing and fixed-model plumbing is deterministic and technically safe to present for separate Phase D2 authorization.
acceptance_rule: Every in-scope gating item must be PASS. Nongating inherited caveats remain explicit. D2 work remains deferred.

requirements.evidence: D1 independently pins the accepted D0 v2 plan, reference, registry and manifest SHA-256 values; the D0 validator passes.
Expected 5e971924023e6e19226269771a40492d113ebc43 is the direct parent of actual starting HEAD cbddb4ff13f4452aa37f427f0f3c09a3f3da1ae4; the intervening commit adds only the D0 review table.
Candidate and market-state paths, run IDs, logical identities and physical hashes are explicit and revalidated; no mutable latest pointer is used.
Fixture tests construct exact decision-session rows and reject missing, duplicate, 59-row and 61-row official membership states.
Stock and market predictors attach only from the immediately preceding official session; decision-session price mutation does not alter predictors.
Observation timestamps are fixed at 08:45 Europe/Warsaw on the decision session.
Expected 60 is retained independently from feature/model eligibility; 57 usable members remain visibly 57/60 with three exclusions.

Prelisting, documented non-trading, unresolved identity/treatment, invalid basis, missing price/volume, exact-lookback and market/cross-section states are causal and restricted to the frozen D0 vocabulary.
Whole-bar source switches are neutral when resolved; unresolved treatment and an unpinned factor version invalidate every crossing price and volume window.
All six frozen conventional formulas, exact windows, sample-volatility convention, ranges and missing behavior are hand/synthetic fixture-tested.
All eight frozen path formulas and missing behavior are fixture-tested without replacement or post-result redesign.
All four average-tie percentile ranks retain n/60, require exactly 45 eligible members, ignore missing members and are invariant to identity/source/order.

All 12 accepted v2 variables use preceding-session membership, IQR, positive top-five leadership, centered volatility ratio, complete vectors, explicit aggregation states and current/lag breadth denominators.
All 30 normalized formula declarations are unique; any outside-P normalized collision fails closed. Independent review found no frozen-formula defect or symbolic affine collision.
Exact, numerical affine, near-threshold, negative-Spearman, connected-component and preference-tie fixtures pass the frozen label-blind rule.
The permitted through-2024-12-30 structural population retains all 8 P features; no exact, algebraic or near-duplicate edge is present.
Repository-authorized synthetic fixtures prove start open at session zero, exact +20 official-session endpoint, gap-independent counting and explicit missing/right-censor states.
Label values are sealed synthetic-only; feature and X boundaries reject predictive columns; arbitrary or relabeled payloads cannot reach the label builder or observation attachment.
Whole decision sessions remain indivisible and fit precedes calibration precedes evaluation in all four frozen folds.
Retention is derived from exact endpoint timestamps; adversarial calendar fixtures disagree with naive row subtraction and pass the correct rule.
Ridge median imputation and standardization fit only on the authorized fit fixture; LightGBM keeps native NaNs; evaluation values cannot refit transformations.
C_LINEAR, C_LIGHTGBM, RICH_LINEAR and RICH_LIGHTGBM have exact frozen allowlists, common score rows and identity-neutral numerical/provenance hashes.
Only ordered registered feature names enter matrices; identity, source, lineage, sector, label, raw-volume and unregistered missing-indicator columns fail.
Model and label execution is admitted only for repository-registered logical/content hashes; arbitrary copied frames and changed payloads cannot be sealed.
Frozen sklearn Ridge pipeline and parameters are deterministic and recover the known linear fixture with correlation above 0.99.
Frozen LightGBM parameters, native NaNs, no early stopping/search, deterministic repeated outputs and nonlinear plumbing pass.
Constant no-signal targets produce constant zero predictions and all-missing fit features fail closed for both models.
Scores require a sealed fitted state bound to adapter class, estimator identity/hash, fixture suite, feature names and fit provenance; unfitted/manual state and estimator replacement fail.
Threshold is fixed to max(0.01, linear p90), accepts provenance-bearing synthetic scores only, uses strict greater-than and permits zero candidates without quota or relaxation.
No-tie, boundary-tie, multi-tie, all-tied, k=0, k>=n and reordered/renamed fixtures prove exact identity-neutral weights and weighted mean/rate.

Synthetic, real_structural and real_predictive contexts are explicit; exact pinned identity is required structurally; all real fit/predict operations are rejected and copied/renamed data cannot bypass content admission.
Only 13 frozen candidate columns were loaded; open/labels/scores/IC/tail/economics were not loaded or derived and market-state values were not loaded.
Only a sealed builder result can publish; strict schema, authorization, pins, projections, counts and hashes are validated before atomic immutable publication.
Two consecutive structural-resolve executions returned the identical run ID, logical hash and physical file hashes.
Supported source/python suite: 171 passed; focused D1: 64 passed; pre-Phase-D market state: 10 passed; D0 validator: PASS.
Inherited candidate-panel caveat: authoritative exhaustive split-event discovery remains unproven. D1 preserves the frozen candidate identity and does not claim canonical migration.
D1 proves timestamp and PIT data semantics, not live auction-feed latency or executable availability at 08:45. This cannot be promoted to deployment evidence.
No real model was fit or selected; MODEL_SELECTION_2022 remains unopened by a model.
No real predictions, IC, correlations, tails, performance or economics were calculated.
Complete moving-block inference and leave-security-out verdict machinery remain D2 work.
Full episode accounting, concentration, contribution and decisive tail gates remain D2 work.
No trade, order, position, capital, cost or portfolio abstraction was added; Phase C is untouched.
D1 makes no predictive STOP/CONTINUE decision; separate owner authorization is required before D2.
